response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count, AVG(g.invoice_count - a.avg_invoice_count) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE g.invoice_count > a.avg_invoice_count;
